main_text.p: 5. Sic in iudicio Rex Deus vltimo Secernens reprobos seliget a bonis. Ad laeuam tremulos reiiciet reos, Ad dextram statuet bonos.
6. Nam nouit Dominus dissimilem gregem, Quo iustus graditur, quo pede claudicat Prauus, iure Deus quemque remunerat: At certum exitium est mali.
main_text.head: PSALMVS II. CONSTAT
main_text.p: 1. VNde haec seditio? ecquid vano regna tumultu Exagitata fremunt?
2. Consiliis habitis Domino Christoque minantur Consspicui proceres.
3. Vincula rumpamus (dicunt) & dura capistra, Excutiamus onus.
4. Sed Deus e solio subsannans murmura, Regum Despuet ipse minas.
5. Tum sic terrifica Reges affabitur ira, Talia verba sonans.
6. Nonne vncto Regi sublimi in monte Sionis Sacra corona data est?
7. Filius hic meus est: sunt haec decreta Tonantis, Hunc hodie genui.
8. Heus fili, poscas, meus es successor & haeres: Plurima regna dabo.

page.notes: Verse 1 "VNde" printed with a large initial V; the title line "xii.verfib.Hebræis" is printed in small type, read as stated. Verse 6 "vncto" has an unusual o/ō-like character, read as printed; uncertain. Verse 5 "Tum sic" and verse 8 "Heus fili, poscas" are rendered as printed, with a comma after "fili" as in the scan. Punctuation is approximate where the scan is faint. Verse-number "5." in the first stanza is printed as a dot after the number.
